final: SELECT School, City, CASE WHEN AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL THEN AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 ELSE NULL END as Administrator1, CASE WHEN AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL THEN AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 ELSE NULL END as Administrator2, CASE WHEN AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL THEN AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 ELSE NULL END as Administrator3 FROM schools WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2' ORDER BY School
